wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-002 pins the BSP front-to-back walk that feeds the solidsegs + wall clipping + wall column drawing passes. The new src/vanilla/wireBspWallRenderer.ts exposes walkBspFromViewpoint(mapData, viewX, viewY) which iteratively descends the BSP tree using the read-only pointOnSide primitive, emitting visible subsectors in canonical front-to-back order. The traversal is deterministic and produces a permutation of subsector indices (every subsector exactly once) per the vanilla R_RenderBSPNode contract. The read-only src/render/solidWalls.ts, src/render/wallColumns.ts, and src/map/nodeTraversal.ts modules are consumed verbatim — the actual wall rendering passes are exercised by later render-lane steps that consume the front-to-back subsector list this step produces.
publicSurface: walkBspFromViewpoint(mapData: MapData, viewX: Fixed, viewY: Fixed): readonly number[]
